text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Powerhouse Umamusume gather on the day of the Hanshin J.F. Surrounded by opponents who are clearly more skilled than her, Vodka starts to feel the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I advise her that it's cooler to lose with style than give up without trying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Those words ease some of her stress, and Vodka bravely takes on the race.
